patches.name: Advanced downloads
patches.description: Adds more ways to save: pick the video quality, save full-size photos, the sound on its own or a photo post as one video, hold a profile picture or story to save it, save a story or a video's cover from the share sheet, and pick videos on a profile grid to save in one run. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches.description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one, and Add to Story in the share sheet when the creator turned off content reuse. PineDrama may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Share sheet.

patches.name: Allow photo comments
patches.description: Lets PineDrama's comment box ask PineDrama's server about photo comments, like PineDrama does. PineDrama's server still decides whether your account can post one. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Comments.

patches.name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
patches.description: Lets screenshots, screen recordings and Circle to Search work on PineDrama screens that would otherwise come out black. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App, then restart PineDrama.

patches.name: Always show publish date
patches.description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, dates and lengths on profile grids, or sort the videos a grid has loaded. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Automatic video advance
patches.description: Moves on to the next video by itself when one ends, so you can watch hands-free. It can also turn on PineDrama's auto scroll in search results. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Playback.

options.title: Default: auto advance hide panel action

patches.name: Block P2P video relay
patches.description: Removes the files PineDrama uses to pass videos on to other viewers through your phone's internet connection. The app gets about 3.5 MB smaller. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it brings them back.

patches.name: Block contact list access
patches.description: Gives PineDrama an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Block installed app scanning
patches.description: Gives PineDrama an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from PineDrama still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Block suggested video notifications
patches.description: Stops PineDrama's "Videos you might like" notifications about popular videos it picked for you. Messages, comments, likes and posts from people you follow still come through. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Camera and microphone indicator
patches.description: Shows a small mark in the top corner while PineDrama is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Change app name
patches.description: Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched PineDrama is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says PineDrama.

options.title: App name
options.description: The name shown under the app icon, up to 50 characters.

patches.name: Comment publish diagnostics
patches.description: Adds a note to HushPine's diagnostic report about how far a comment got when it fails to post, which helps track down comments that vanish without an error. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Comment send fix
patches.description: Fixes comments that PineDrama sometimes drops without any message, so the comment you send actually posts. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Comment sort controls
patches.description: Shows PineDrama's full comment sort menu on every video, with hot, newest, media and creator options, even when your account only got a cut-down version. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Comments.

patches.name: Copy comments without username
patches.description: When you copy a comment, you get just its text, without the username in front. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Comments.

patches.name: Create stickers
patches.description: Adds a Create button to the Saved page of the comment sticker panel. Pick a photo and it turns into one of your saved stickers. Make sticker in a video's share sheet does the same with its cover. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches.description: Lets you pick how many videos PineDrama saves for watching offline, from 1 to 10,000, and keep them until you delete them. Handy when you're often without internet. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Device privacy guard
patches.description: Stops PineDrama reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools, and give PineDrama a new device identity. Each switch starts off in HushPine settings > Privacy. Changing Hide root needs a restart.

patches.name: Diagnostic tools
patches.description: Adds logs and reports you can save or share when something goes wrong, so a problem is easier to report and fix. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Diagnostics.

options.title: Default: morphe debug toast on error

patches.name: Disable login requirement
patches.description: Stops PineDrama from forcing you to sign in before you can keep browsing. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches.description: Stops PineDrama from noticing and reacting when you take a screenshot or record the screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Disable the long press quick share
patches.description: Stops a long press on Share from opening PineDrama's quick share, so you don't send a video by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Feed screen.

options.title: Default: disable long press quick share

patches.name: Disable the long press repost
patches.description: Stops a long press on Like from opening PineDrama's repost option, so you don't repost by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Downloads
patches.description: Saves videos and photos without PineDrama's watermark, even when the creator turned downloads off. You can also choose the folders and file names. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Downloads.

options.title: Default: download comment media filename template
Default: skip post download share sheet

patches.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches.description: Lets you make PineDrama decode animated stickers and GIFs one frame at a time as they play, instead of a few frames ahead, so they use a little less memory. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.

patches.name: Enable voice comments
patches.description: Lets you turn on PineDrama's voice comments, so you can record and post a spoken comment, for accounts that don't have them yet. It hasn't been tried on a real account, so it may not work. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Comments.

patches.name: Expand activity list
patches.description: Shows the whole Activity and New followers lists in the Inbox, so you don't have to tap View all. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches.description: Adds an advanced page that lists the hidden settings PineDrama uses to test features and lets you change them. It's for people who like to experiment. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Diagnostics.

patches.name: Feature Gate Recorder
patches.description: Records which hidden PineDrama settings the app reads while you use it, and which ones changed. It's a research tool and changes nothing in PineDrama. Start a recording in HushPine settings > Diagnostics.

patches.name: Feed filter
patches.description: Hides ads in the feed, and lets you hide other things you don't want to see, like LIVEs, Shop posts, AI videos or videos with words, creators or sounds you pick. Hiding ads is on by default. Everything else starts off in HushPine settings > Feed filter.

patches.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches.description: Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen, and fits photo slideshows whole on squarer screens. A second switch does the opposite and fills the screen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Playback.

patches.name: Fix Google login
patches.description: Makes Sign in with Google work in the patched app, where it would otherwise fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Ghost mode
patches.description: Stops PineDrama telling people you viewed their story or profile, or that you're typing. What PineDrama already recorded stays. A separate switch hides your online status. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide Play Store update offer
patches.description: Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched PineDrama for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase PineDrama's data on your phone.

patches.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches.description: Stops the brand animation that pops up over the comments when someone types a word or emoji an advertiser paid for. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Comments.

patches.name: Hide comment typing suggestions
patches.description: Hides the emoji and sticker suggestions that pop up above the comment box while you type. The emoji and sticker buttons still work. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Comments.

patches.name: Hide feed follow button
patches.description: Removes the + follow button under creators' pictures on the feed, so you don't follow someone by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Hide feed save button
patches.description: Removes the save button from the right side of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Hide feed search button
patches.description: Removes the search button from the top right of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Hide floating promotions
patches.description: Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Feed screen, and App for the rewards button.

patches.name: Hide inbox items
patches.description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests and TikTok Shop, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Inbox.

options.title: Default: hide inbox group chat banner
Default: turn off chat double tap
Default: turn off chat swipe reply

patches.name: Hide profile shortcuts
patches.description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from under a profile's bio, if PineDrama shows any there. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App, then restart PineDrama.

patches.name: Hide search suggestions
patches.description: Hides the searches PineDrama suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.

patches.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches.description: Hides PineDrama's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches.description: Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold PineDrama's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.

patches.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches.description: Turns on PineDrama's own gesture where you hold a video, slide down and let go to keep it playing fast without holding. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Feed screen.

options.title: Default: enable long press speed lock

patches.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches.description: Stops websites you open in PineDrama's built-in browser from reaching into the PineDrama app. PineDrama's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Keep a streak going
patches.description: Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open PineDrama. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Keep playing in the background
patches.description: Keeps the video playing when you leave PineDrama or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. It can also start the video over when it ends. Handy for music and talks. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Playback, then restart PineDrama.

patches.name: Keep pulled sounds
patches.description: Plays the sound on videos PineDrama muted for copyright or because of where you live. PineDrama may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Playback.

patches.name: Keep recent stickers
patches.description: Adds Recently used above Saved in the comment sticker panel, with the last stickers you sent, and keeps it when you close and reopen the app. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches.description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when PineDrama tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when PineDrama is. Both are on by default. Turn them off in HushPine settings > App.

patches.name: Keep the app language
patches.description: Lets you keep the language you picked in PineDrama's own settings. When PineDrama starts and decides the phone's language changed, it drops that pick and follows the phone, which can leave it in the wrong language after a reboot. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.

patches.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches.description: Stops PineDrama slowing your screen down to the video's frame rate, so scrolling stays smooth on 90 or 120 Hz phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.

patches.name: Limit background traffic
patches.description: Lets you stop PineDrama loading upcoming videos ahead of time, which uses less data in the background, but videos may take a moment longer to start. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.

options.title: Skip notification setup
options.description: With this on, the Limit background traffic switch in HushPine settings also stops PineDrama setting up notifications, so you won't get any, messages included. Turn the switch off or pause HushPine to get them back.

patches.name: Load all saved stickers
patches.description: Loads every sticker you saved when you open the sticker panel. PineDrama otherwise shows only the first 100 and never loads the rest. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Location access governor
patches.description: Gives PineDrama no location when it asks, so it can't see where you are from your phone's location services. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Look like the store app
patches.description: Makes the patched app answer PineDrama's checks as if it came from the Play Store, which can help when follows or likes undo themselves. PineDrama has other checks, so it may not be enough. On once picked. Turn it off in HushPine settings > App.

patches.name: Network proxy
patches.description: Sends PineDrama's feed, search and comments through a proxy server you set up. Videos and LIVEs still load directly, and so do HushPine's own saves and short-link lookups. Other apps aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Region, then restart PineDrama.

patches.name: Network request report
patches.description: Counts the requests PineDrama sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in PineDrama, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.

patches.name: Notification controls
patches.description: Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which PineDrama has no switch for, or turn off PineDrama's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Open external links directly
patches.description: Opens website links from profiles and stories in your phone's own browser instead of PineDrama's built-in one. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Open the comments at full height
patches.description: Opens the comment sheet at the full height of the screen instead of part way up. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Comments.

patches.name: Play SDR instead of HDR
patches.description: Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Playback.

patches.name: Playback quality
patches.description: Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in HushPine settings > Playback.

patches.name: Playback speed
patches.description: Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Playback.

patches.name: Prefer H.264 playback
patches.description: Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Playback.

patches.name: Profile background
patches.description: Opens PineDrama's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts PineDrama hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. PineDrama's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.

patches.name: Region spoof
patches.description: Makes PineDrama's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Region.

patches.name: Remember clear display
patches.description: Keeps clear display, PineDrama's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video (`Keep Clear display across videos` turns that part off). It can also turn on by itself after a delay you pick, which starts off in HushPine settings > Feed screen. When clear display ends, the Following stories bubble PineDrama hid comes back too.

options.title: Default: remember clear display on scroll

patches.name: Remove unused language packs
patches.description: Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.

options.title: Languages to keep
options.description: The languages to keep, as short codes separated by commas, like en, es, pt, fr or de. Type all to keep every language. English is always kept.

patches.name: Resource and battery governor
patches.description: Stops PineDrama reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches.description: When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Playback.

patches.name: SIM spoof
patches.description: Makes PineDrama see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since PineDrama also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Region.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes the tracking codes from PineDrama links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Settings
patches.description: Adds the HushPine settings page to PineDrama, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding any tab at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn HushPine's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Show LIVE search
patches.description: Adds PineDrama's search button inside the LIVE section where PineDrama supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.

patches.name: Show commenter handle and region
patches.description: Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushPine settings > Comments.

patches.name: Show the progress bar
patches.description: Shows the progress bar on videos where PineDrama hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Playback, where you can also show the time beside the bar or give it a bigger handle. Seek bars for video stories and sound previews are there too.

patches.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches.description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in HushPine settings > Playback.

patches.name: Skip content warnings
patches.description: Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Skip first-launch setup
patches.description: Skips PineDrama's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in HushPine settings > App.

patches.name: Skip passkey sign-in
patches.description: Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when PineDrama wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, PineDrama treats your phone as one without passkeys. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.

patches.name: Skip the splash ad
patches.description: Lets you stop the full-screen ad PineDrama can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.

patches.name: Skip update checks
patches.description: Lets you stop two background tasks PineDrama uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.

patches.name: Stay on the video in full screen
patches.description: When a video ends in PineDrama's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Playback.

patches.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches.description: Lets you stop PineDrama's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything PineDrama logs about your use. PineDrama works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Stop recording watch history
patches.description: Stops PineDrama adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and your feed learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Stop saving search history
patches.description: Stops PineDrama saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and PineDrama's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Stop search autoplay
patches.description: Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.

patches.name: Translate comments
patches.description: Translates comments as they load, using PineDrama's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > Comments, where more rows list languages PineDrama's automatic translation should leave alone, keep videos in the language they were made in, pick the language translations come out in, and add PineDrama's translate button beside the comment count.

patches.name: Trust user certificates
patches.description: Lets PineDrama trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read PineDrama's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.

patches.name: Turn off haptics
patches.description: Stops the little vibrations PineDrama makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.

patches.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches.description: Opens and closes PineDrama's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.

patches.name: Use non-personalized search
patches.description: Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App.

patches.name: Use system font
patches.description: Shows PineDrama's text in your phone's own font or in a .ttf or .otf font file you import, instead of PineDrama's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPine settings > App, then restart PineDrama.
